actions.name: check_otp_status
actions.description: Check the delivery and validity status of a MyOTP.App OTP message.

message_id.description: The message identifier of the OTP to inspect.

inputSchema.description: The input for checking an OTP message status.

status.description: The delivery status returned by MyOTP.App.

is_valid.description: Whether the OTP is still active and valid.

expires_at.description: The OTP expiry timestamp in UTC.

outputSchema.description: The current delivery and validity status of an OTP message.

actions.name: extend_otp
actions.description: Extend the expiry time of an existing MyOTP.App OTP.

message_id.description: The message identifier of the OTP to extend.

duration.description: The number of seconds to add to the OTP expiry time.

inputSchema.description: The input for extending an OTP expiry time.

message.description: The human-readable message returned by MyOTP.App.

expires_at.description: The new OTP expiry timestamp in UTC.

outputSchema.description: The result of extending an OTP expiry time.

actions.name: generate_otp
actions.description: Generate and deliver an OTP through MyOTP.App by SMS or WhatsApp.

phone_number.description: The E.164 phone number including country code without a prefix.

otp_length.description: The number of digits in the generated OTP.

otp_validity.description: The OTP validity period in seconds.

channel.description: The channel used to deliver the OTP.

force_send.description: Whether to send a new OTP while an unexpired OTP exists.

return_otp.description: Whether to include the generated OTP in the response when permitted.

brand.description: The alphanumeric brand name that overrides the account default.

inputSchema.description: The input for generating and delivering an OTP.

message_id.description: The unique identifier of the sent OTP message.

message.description: The human-readable message returned by MyOTP.App.

date_sent.description: The UTC timestamp when the OTP was sent.

expires_at.description: The UTC timestamp when the OTP expires.

cost.description: The cost charged for delivering the OTP.

otp.description: The generated OTP when return_otp was requested and permitted.

outputSchema.description: The OTP generation result returned by MyOTP.App.

actions.name: get_transactions_report
actions.description: Retrieve a paginated MyOTP.App transaction report for a date range.

start_date.description: The first report date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: The last report date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

per_page.description: The maximum number of transactions to return.

inputSchema.description: The filters and pagination for a MyOTP.App transaction report.

message_id.description: The unique identifier of the OTP message.

message_type.description: The numeric transaction type assigned by MyOTP.App.

force_send.description: Whether the OTP was sent while another OTP was still active.

client_ip.description: The client IP recorded by MyOTP.App.

application.description: The application assigned to the API key.

created_at.description: The transaction creation timestamp in UTC.

items.description: A transaction returned by the MyOTP.App report endpoint.

transactions.description: The transactions in the requested report page.

actions.name: verify_otp
actions.description: Verify an OTP using its message id or destination phone number.

message_id.description: The message identifier returned when the OTP was generated.

phone_number.description: The E.164 phone number used to generate the OTP.

inputSchema.description: The input for verifying a MyOTP.App OTP.

reason.description: The reason the verification failed when supplied.

outputSchema.description: The OTP verification result returned by MyOTP.App.
